note: Strengths cover the opposing forces on the Plains of Abraham, not the entire Quebec campaign or 13,000-man French garrison. NDU identifies about 4,000 British and 4,500 French-led combatants. NAM reports roughly 650 British and 640 French killed or wounded, without a separate death toll. Flintlock infantry is representative; Indigenous allies and militia are not assigned a uniform or a fabricated share.
